detail.title: Clamp capable of realizing workpiece press-fitting and airtightness detection
detail.abstract: The invention discloses a clamp capable of realizing workpiece press-fitting and airtightness detection. The clamp is used for detecting the airtightness of the cavity of die-casting. The clamp comprises a main air cylinder or oil cylinder, an airtight sleeve, a sealing loop, a guide pillar, a guide plate, a movable plate, a buffer spring, a support pillar, a lower sealing gland, a lateral air cylinder, a main sealing pressure head, a lateral sealing gland, a pressure sensor and the like. According to the working principle, the main sealing pressure head is pressed into the main hole of a detected workpiece to seal the main hole, the support pillar in the hole is used for pressing the lower sealing gland into the lower hole in the detected workpiece to form sealing; and the lateral air cylinder is used for pressing a bushing into the lateral hole of the detected workpiece and is extruded into the hole to form sealing, and the cavity of the detected workpiece is filled with the introduced compressed air. The detection result can be obtained by judging the pressure change. The clamp has the advantages of high detection speed, small influence by manual interference, reliable detection, visual and accurate detection result, high detection efficiency, convenience in operation, small operation intensity and the like, and can be used for detecting the airtightness in batches.
